pairs.new: For a debate created before the ASK 505 write time (`v_505_from`, 2026-11-20 04:44:38Z): both sides: UNDERDETERMINED; the challenger alone: DEFENDER PREVAILS, and a DEFENDER PREVAILS, WEAKENED stays as it is; the defender alone: CHALLENGER PREVAILS. For a debate created at or after it (ASK 505 C1, the operator's card "Both sides (B)"): a forfeit only takes a win away from the side that made it, and never hands a win to the other side: the defender forfeits and the outcome is DEFENDER PREVAILS or DEFENDER PREVAILS, WEAKENED: UNDERDETERMINED; the challenger forfeits and the outcome is CHALLENGER PREVAILS: UNDERDETERMINED; any other outcome stays (so both sides forfeiting still gives UNDERDETERMINED for any win). The sides found are returned as `close_forfeit`. STANDING GATE (ASK 505 C0; the operator, 22:29 CST 11-19: "You can't with a PROP SUPPORTED by two or more judges", corrected "can't win"; card "Yes, always"): for a debate created at or after `v_505_from`, after the close forfeit, an outcome that names a side as prevailing (DEFENDER PREVAILS, DEFENDER PREVAILS, WEAKENED, CHALLENGER PREVAILS) becomes UNDERDETERMINED when that side's own standing (CHALLENGE STANDING for the challenger, DEFENSE STANDING for the defender) begins with PROP-DEPENDENT or COLLAPSED on two or more counted seats. Both sides; it applies even when the RESULT words agree. Earlier debates keep their outcome; stored rows are not rewritten. Then the citation rule applies as below.
